Abstract:Automated animal re-identification from photograph sequences can facilitate minimally invasive Capture-Mark-Recapture studies at scale. Yet, photographs taken during an observation session can vary greatly in quality, not always providing the necessary information for accurate re-identification. In this paper, we present new methods for taxonomic classification, sex determination, and open-set re-identification from image sequences. We train and evaluate our models on a dataset of 35,914 photographs of 474 individual seahorses observed in the wild. We demonstrate that our approach, by combining information from multiple photographs, yields state-of-the-art performance.

72. 【2610.39848】LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39848

作者：Alexandros Gkillas,Ioulia Kapsali,Christos Anagnostopoulos,Aris S. Lalos

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

关键词：perception underpins autonomous, underpins autonomous driving, safely requires stress-testing, models safely requires, perception underpins

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware suite of state-of-the-art attacks, including PGD and Square Attack for segmentation, and point perturbation, point removal, point injection, and LiDAttack for detection. This enables systematic exposure of corner cases and vulnerabilities across heterogeneous LiDAR backbones. The LiDAR-Shield codebase is publicly available at this https URL.

73. 【2610.39835】Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39835

作者：Hongyu Bai,Jiaqi Zeng,Chunzheng Zhu

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

关键词：requires verifiable links, current medical vision, medical vision language, vision language models, reasoning requires verifiable

备注： Accepted at ACM Multimedia Asia 2026 (MMAsia 2026). 10 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization (DBPO) concentrates learning on this calibrated boundary region. Second, we distill reusable clinical rubrics from boundary trajectories and activate them according to prediction entropy. Entropy Gated Grounded Policy Optimization (EGPO) rewards answer correctness, anatomical grounding, and reasoning fidelity while suppressing rubric noise on reliable samples. A reference policy anchored to the boundary-aligned model couples population-level boundary priors with instance-level uncertainty, making diagnostic reasoning more accurate and clinically grounded. Experiments on six medical benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong general, specialized, and reinforcement learning baselines, reaching 61.2% average accuracy with the largest gains on challenging differential diagnosis tasks. Ablations show super-additive gains: combining the two stages exceeds the sum of their individual improvements.

74. 【2610.39812】GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39812

作者：Fang Yu,Xiaoxue Wu,Haiyu Zhang,Yangfu Li,Botong Zhao,Yu Qiao,Tianfan Xue,Yue Lu,Xinyuan Chen

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：observed content falls, video world models, world models, Local Memory Retrieval, consistency is essential

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-horizon consistency is essential for video world models, yet it becomes difficult to maintain once observed content falls outside the context window. Existing memory mechanisms either retrieve history as implicit context, which remains constrained by context capacity and entangles static and dynamic information or consolidate history into explicit global representations, which struggle to model evolving dynamics and accumulate geometric errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce \textbf{GROME}, a novel factorized memory framework that augments video world models for long-horizon coherence across both static scenes and dynamic entities. GROME operates via three synergistic components: 1)~\emph{Static-Dynamic Factorization} decouples historical evidence into static and dynamic components, preserving static scene geometry and dynamic entity states separately; 2)~\emph{Local Memory Retrieval} selects spatially aligned static history to eliminate geometric drift alongside the latest dynamic entity states to ensure temporal continuity; 3)~\emph{Training-Free Memory Injection} seamlessly grounds the factorized memory into video world models via their native conditioning pathways. Experiments on long-horizon revisit scenarios demonstrate that GROME substantially enhances scene persistence and dynamic entity fidelity over existing methods, all while preserving the visual quality and controllability of the frozen backbone without additional training. Beyond self-rollouts, GROME readily accommodates external observations as plug-and-play memory, unlocking flexible and controllable video continuation and scene exploration.

75. 【2610.39778】SCOPE: Semantic COdec Pre-Editing for Object-Preserving Compression

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39778

作者：Silvia Dani,Leonardo Galteri,Marco Bertini

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：machine vision systems, downstream task accuracy, vision systems, machine vision, optimized for human

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Image compression is increasingly used before machine vision systems, yet standard codecs are mainly optimized for human perception rather than downstream task accuracy. We propose SCOPE (Semantic COdec Pre-Editing), a conditional image pre-editor that modifies images before compression to improve the bitrate and detection accuracy trade-off. The model is conditioned on the codec family and compression severity, allowing a single trained network to adapt to multiple compression settings without retraining or loading codec-specific weights. Instead of uniformly preserving the whole image, the pre-editor learns to protect task-relevant regions while simplifying less important background content to improve compressibility. The resulting rate-accuracy curves show consistent gains across different codec families and detector architectures, together with strong transferability to unseen learned and wavelet-based compression families.

76. 【2610.39773】Quantum-Inspired Convolutional Networks for High-Resolution Pseudo-Label Generation from Multimodal Earth Observation Data

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39773

作者：Abhishek Singh,Giovanni Cuozzo,Alexander Jacob,Claudia Notarnicola

类目：Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Accurate land-cover mapping, multimodal Earth observation, Earth observation, Accurate land-cover, costly to obtain

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Accurate land-cover mapping from multimodal Earth observation (EO) data remains a challenge in regions where high-resolution annotations are scarce or costly to obtain. This work introduces a quantum convolutional encoder-decoder network for pseudo-label generation using Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, guided only by coarse MODIS-derived land-cover maps. The proposed framework uses quantum-inspired convolutional blocks to enhance feature extraction and cross-sensor fusion, enabling the model to infer a fine-scale semantic structure from heterogeneous inputs. Experiments were conducted on the DFC2020 dataset, which provides a quadruple of Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 multispectral, low-resolution MODIS labels and high-resolution reference land-cover maps. The proposed training framework first learns a robust representation of multimodal inputs through the reconstruction branch before any supervision from low-resolution labels is applied. This self-supervised stage enables the model to capture a fine-scale spectral-spatial structure, which is then used to generate high-resolution pseudo-labels. These pseudo-labels are subsequently evaluated through classification metrics on the test data, demonstrating that the proposed approach produces more spatially coherent and class-consistent compared to classical baselines. The results highlight the potential of quantum-inspired deep learning to improve label generation in low-annotation remote sensing scenarios, offering a scalable path towards high-quality land-cover products for EO applications.

77. 【2610.39727】Cross-Encoder Anchor Refinement for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39727

作者：Kaisong Ji,Ziyang Xu,Chang Bian,Yu Zhou,Wenyu Liu,Xinggang Wang

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：localizing subtle defects, auxiliary training domains, transfer anomaly discrimination, Zero-shot anomaly detection, subtle defects

备注： 15 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to transfer anomaly discrimination from auxiliary training domains to unseen categories while localizing subtle defects. A key challenge is to construct discriminative references that combine contextual representations with complementary local evidence. We present Cross-Encoder Anchor Refinement (CEAR), which connects two visual encoding paths for the same image at the anchor stage, before normal and anomalous prototypes are constructed. An independent convolutional encoder pretrained for industrial product recognition builds an image-specific memory shared across selected vision transformer (ViT) layers. Spatial anchors read from ViT patch features query this memory through cross-attention and undergo residual refinement. Image-conditioned normal and anomalous queries then gate anchor aggregation to construct prototypes for anomaly scoring. Across 13 industrial and medical datasets, CEAR achieves the best performance in 57 of 68 evaluations spanning image-level detection and pixel-level localization. Notably, CEAR surpasses all other state-of-the-art methods in 41 of 44 pixel-level comparisons. Across 11 localization datasets, mean gains in pixel-level maximum F1 score and average precision are 4.45 and 3.79 percentage points, respectively. This study shows how cross-encoder interaction at the anchor stage can integrate complementary visual representations for fine-grained anomaly localization across domains.

78. 【2610.39721】WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39721

作者：Minqi Wang,Jie Peng,Hejun Dong,Ruchang Yao,Puyi Wang,Siyuan Huang,Jihai Zhang,Yafu Li,Qi Dou,Xiaoye Qu,Yu Cheng

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：future visual observations, time and space, Video world models, goal of synthesizing, explored across time

备注： 19 pages, 9 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Video world models generate future visual observations from camera or action inputs, with the goal of synthesizing persistent 3D worlds that can be explored across time and space. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate short interactions or rely on camera trajectories fixed before generation. The performance of video world models under long-horizon exploration with extensive camera motion remains under-explored. We introduce WorldProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that uses a goal-conditioned multimodal agent to adapt camera actions online during generation. WorldProbe comprises 164 test cases across four probing families. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, we generate more than 1,600 rollouts totaling approximately 800 minutes, with horizons up to 180 seconds. Our evaluation across four dimensions reveals both the degradation of local measures and the emergence of long-range inconsistencies. We find that recent models sustain visual and content quality for longer, while long-range memory and evolution remain weak. These results expose a gap between locally stable generation and persistent world consistency that is largely missed by existing benchmarks. Code and benchmark resources are available at this https URL.

79. 【2610.39715】NIF: Normal-Intersection Fields for Geometrically Consistent Oriented Box Refinement

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39715

作者：Shaokai Zheng

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Accurate oriented detection, standard regression head, oriented detection requires, regression head predicts, follow object boundaries

备注： 17 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Accurate oriented detection requires a box to follow object boundaries, yet a standard regression head predicts its center, size, and angle from a pooled region representation. Small errors in these coupled parameters can displace long boundaries even when the object is correctly classified. We propose NIF, a refinement module that replaces an additional box regressor with normal-intersection fields. Given a coarse oriented box, the module observes local features at 20 boundary anchors and predicts signed distances along their outward normals. These observations admit an exact affine representation in five geometric variables. A differentiable, reliability-weighted least-squares fit projects the predicted field onto this representation and analytically recovers a refined rectangle. Tangential pooling preserves the normal position profile, while shared projection limits the added network to 0.132M parameters. On DOTA-v1.0, NIF reaches 78.00%, 79.11%, and 79.02% mAP with Oriented R-CNN, LSKNet-S, and Strip R-CNN, respectively, achieving the highest single-scale SOTA result in Table 1. It reaches 68.19% on DIOR-R, improves matched FAIR1M/DIOR-R baselines by 0.30/0.68%, and raises HRSC mean IoU from 0.867 to 0.888 while reducing field error by 24.5%. Across four different detector frameworks with the detectors frozen, relative AP75 improves by 1.57-4.18% and COCO-style mAP by 0.42-3.74%, without detector retraining. Code is available at this https URL.

80. 【2610.39704】Confidence Filtering in Video-Based Gait Assessment: Measurement Error versus Selection Shift

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39704

作者：David Regev,Eran Beeri Bamani

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Quantitative Methods (q-bio.QM); Methodology (stat.ME)

关键词：Video-based gait assessment, high-confidence pose observations, Video-based gait, pose observations, gait assessment

备注： 6 pages + 2-page appendix, 4 figures, 2 supplementary figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Rehabilitation Robotics (ICORR)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Video-based gait assessment often keeps only high-confidence pose observations, which can lower measurement error but change the movement assessed. We compared confidence selection with budget-matched random selection in a Parkinson-related cohort (n = 96) and an NF2-related replication cohort (n = 18). In the Parkinson-related cohort, confidence selection produced a small but consistent shift in the observed movement summary (+0.05 SD, 95% CI 0.03 to 0.07), while held-out Mini-BESTest error stayed flat (-0.04 points, -0.13 to 0.05); a policy preserving motion-group proportions reduced the shift, while NF2 showed no shift and its predictor did not beat a constant baseline. Because this shift mixes measurement error with selection shift, we decompose and simulate both on the cohort's window structure. Filtering lowers local error when error depends on confidence, but biases the endpoint once confidence tracks movement more than error. In the Parkinson-related data, confidence was only weakly tied to movement (rho = 0.14). There, filtering is harmless if well-tracked windows are unbiased. If instead systematic error only redistributes within participants, filtering can add up to 0.58 degrees. Unchanged clinical error from such small-cohort predictors therefore cannot show that quality filtering preserves the assessed movement.

81. 【2610.39701】DEQ-Stereo: Deep Euilibrium Video Stereo Matching via Adaptive Convergence

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39701

作者：Kiljoon Han,Kyumin Hwang,Wonheok Choi,Jeonghoon Kim,Sunghoom Im

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Iterative refinement models, update schedules incur, schedules incur heavy, incur heavy computational, heavy computational costs

备注： ACCV2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Iterative refinement models have significantly improved stereo matching accuracy, but their rigid, fixed update schedules incur heavy computational costs and a strict trade-off between speed and accuracy. This challenge is magnified in video streams, where traditional online methods resort to reducing feature channels or relying on expensive temporal warping. To address this, we propose \textbf{DEQ-Stereo}, a novel video stereo matching framework based on the Deep Equilibrium (DEQ) paradigm. Instead of unrolling a fixed number of iterations, DEQ-Stereo reformulates the refinement as an implicit fixed-point problem, adaptively terminating once convergence is met. To ensure fast and stable intra-frame convergence, we introduce the \textbf{Convolutional Simplified Gated Unit (ConvSGU)}, which eliminates unnecessary non-linearities by modeling the latent state as a gated, element-wise sum of inputs. Furthermore, to exploit cross-frame temporal coherence, we propose \textbf{Temporal State Transfer (TST)}, a warm-start strategy that propagates the converged hidden state to the next frame without requiring explicit pose or warping priors. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DEQ-Stereo delivers state-of-the-art performance with a superior accuracy-to-latency trade-off.

82. 【2610.39676】Event-SAMA: Language-Grounded Video Object Segmentation on Neuromorphic Event Streams

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39676

作者：Sergei Fedorchenko,Max Zehnder,Nikola Zubić,Rong Zou,Davide Scaramuzza

类目：Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range, lacks event-stream datasets, cameras offer microsecond, offer microsecond temporal

备注： 15 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range and no motion blur, but referring video object segmentation (RVOS) lacks event-stream datasets and models. We introduce Event-SAMA-239K, a synthetic-event conversion of the SAMA-239K grounded video-chat corpus and all additional SAMA training data: 30,650 video clips and 392,162 images. Optical-flow, FILM or saccade upsampling followed by a linear event generator preserves all mask, referring-expression and dialogue annotations. We also introduce Event-SAMA, adapting SAMA-4B with a two-channel polarity patch embedding initialised from pretrained RGB weights and a zero-initialised event adapter. End-to-end training yields 24.37 $\mathcal{J}\\mathcal{F}$ on MeViS valid_u and 22.33 $\mathcal{J}\\mathcal{F}$ on the converted ReVOS valid subset, establishing the first event-native RVOS baseline (RGB SAMA-4B: 55.4 on MeViS). Frozen RGB SAMA-4B with pseudo-RGB renderings or E2VID reconstructions of the same events scores 13.23 and 15.94 $\mathcal{J}\\mathcal{F}$. Without retraining, Event-SAMA works on real event-camera recordings when the accumulation window matches their event density. A seed-controlled ablation with a measured noise floor of 0.47 $\mathcal{J}\\mathcal{F}$ finds gains from diverse training sources over MeViS alone (+4.99), RGB-mean event-stem initialisation (+4.33), and a trainable SAM2 mask decoder (+2.76); the event adapter, partial ViT unfreezing and event polarity are within noise at this budget. An earlier, partially converted corpus snapshot trained with the identical recipe scores 1.38 $\mathcal{J}\\mathcal{F}$ higher on MeViS and 1.12 higher on ReVOS. Both are single runs that also differ in schedule length, so we draw no conclusion about corpus scale.

83. 【2610.39664】EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39664

作者：Haiyang Xu,Tianyu Wang,Jialu Li,Jiteng Mu,Yuanjun Xiong,Jianming Zhang,Zhuowen Tu,Mingze Xu

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Agentic image editors, decompose complex requests, Agentic image, image editors decompose, editors decompose complex

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic image editors decompose complex requests into steps, but when a step fails, they mostly retry with the same narrow set of tools and a judge that scores each output by eye directly. We argue that such agents are bounded by two spaces: the action space of what the agent can do, and the observation space of what its judge can see. On our expert-annotated benchmark, a general-purpose editor yields no usable result in over 40% of the cases, and no judge is reliable across edit types. We present EditAgent, which expands both spaces. It routes each step to general editors and specialized methods, and attaches to each candidate a verification record. With these records, off-the-shelf VLM judges outperform finetuned reward models. Candidates are generated in parallel and judged in one listwise call: experts prefer this to sequential refinement in 78.5% of decided comparisons, at no more than half the judge calls. EditAgent improves two open-weight editors on three benchmarks and serves as a data engine for training stronger editors.

84. 【2610.39663】AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39663

作者：Bin Xu,Mo Zhang,Zhengfeiyang Zhang,Xinfeng Yang,Yixing Ma,Wei Wang,HeXin Wang,Pengfei Zhou,Wangbo Zhao

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Video diffusion transformers, generate high-quality videos, diffusion transformers generate, transformers generate high-quality, Video diffusion

备注： 20 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but the quadratic cost of 3D full attention dominates their inference. Dynamic block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing exact attention only on key/value blocks selected from current activations. However, its fidelity degrades under aggressive sparsity: blocks are scored from coarse summaries or formed by costly global clustering, pruned blocks vanish from the softmax, and whole tiles are kept or dropped even when only a few of their keys matter. To address these limitations, we propose Accurate Block Attention (AB-Attention), a training-free method that accurately approximates dense attention at high sparsity. Its Intra-Block Clustering Selector (IBCS) estimates block importance faithfully yet cheaply by clustering queries only within each query block, without permuting tokens. Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting (SIP) then samples blocks in proportion to these estimates and reweights them by inverse inclusion probability, so that one pass estimates dense attention rather than truncating it. Finally, its kernel gathers key/value blocks much smaller than a tile into full tensor-core tiles, refining selection at no extra tensor-core cost. On Wan2.1 and HunyuanVideo, AB-Attention skips 89--92\% of attention, whereas the baselines compute 1.8--3.6$\times$ as much, yet it still improves PSNR by up to 4.4~dB over the strongest baseline and achieves up to 2.23$\times$ end-to-end speedup. Our code is available at this https URL.

85. 【2610.39649】Look at Where You Think: Localization-Head Alignment for Fine-Grained Perception in Thinking VLMs

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39649

作者：Yuan Wang,Wei Wu,Hongning Wang

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Thinking vision-language models, miss small details, vision-language models reason, Thinking vision-language, high-resolution images

备注： 23 pages, including references and appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Thinking vision-language models reason for thousands of tokens, yet still miss small details in high-resolution images. Zooming methods pay for extra inference passes, and outcome rewards never tell the model where to look at. In Qwen3.5-4B, we find that the bottleneck is selection, not seeing: a few attention heads, which we call localization heads, pick the evidence out of thousands of visual tokens; ablating four of them costs 13.2 points more than ablating four random heads, and their focus fades as the reasoning grows. We therefore propose Localization-Head Alignment (LHA), which makes attention a training signal: whenever the reasoning states a visual fact, these heads learn to look at the focal region rather than the background, as an auxiliary loss in both SFT and RL training. On benchmarks of V*, HR-Bench 4K and TreeBench, LHA lifts Qwen3.5-4B from 74.1% to 76.6% accuracy, the best single-pass 4B result we evaluate, ahead of multi-pass zooming and released 7B models. Alignment alone adds 1.8 points over otherwise identical training while shortening reasoning by 20%, and the gains carry over to Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

86. 【2610.39648】Annotation-Free Representation Learning for Polyp Retrieval in Colonoscopy Videos

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39648

作者：Luca Parolari,Lamberto Ballan,Carlo Biffi,Loic Le Folgoc

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：reliable visual assessment, complementary views acquired, inherently comparative, reliable visual, imaging conditions

备注： Under submission at ISBI 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Colonoscopy is inherently comparative: reliable visual assessment of polyps often depends on complementary views acquired under different viewpoints and imaging conditions. Retrieving such views requires polyp tracklet representations, which recent contrastive methods learn from temporal cues but still build from manually annotated bounding boxes. We propose an annotation-free framework that constructs tracklet views directly from raw colonoscopy videos, enabling temporal self-supervised learning on full-procedure videos, including frames without visible polyps. On REAL-Colon, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on tracklet retrieval and re-identification, outperforming both self-supervised and supervised baselines. We then introduce few-shot polyp retrieval, a task closer to clinical use, where a few observations of a target polyp are used to retrieve its remaining tracklets: with only two examples, our method surpasses most competing methods given ten. Finally, we show that a modest number of unlabeled procedures suffices for competitive performance, making on-site model development more practical. Code is available at this https URL.

87. 【2610.39646】FlexTry-On: A Time-Efficient Framework for Multi-Scenario Virtual Try-on

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39646

作者：Phuong Dam,Quyen Nguyen Duc,Son Hoang Minh,Daeyoung Kim

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：achieved remarkable progress, Virtual try-on, virtual try-on scenarios, diverse virtual try-on, recent years

Abstract:Virtual try-on has achieved remarkable progress in recent years, yet most existing methods are designed for a specific scenario, such as cloth-to-person or person-to-person try-on, and often require separate conditioning strategies and processing pipelines for different settings. We present FlexTry-On, a unified and time-efficient diffusion-based framework for diverse virtual try-on scenarios, including cloth-to-person, person-to-person, cross-domain, and in-the-wild settings. FlexTry-On adopts a common conditioning formulation, where a text-aware condition extraction strategy converts heterogeneous garment sources into a unified representation, and a dual-conditioning diffusion transformer jointly models garment appearance and person identity. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance on both cloth-to-person and person-to-person benchmarks while maintaining fast inference. Moreover, the same framework can be directly applied to unseen cross-domain scenarios without requiring separate architectures or scenario-specific processing pipelines. These results highlight the potential of unified and efficient virtual try-on frameworks as a practical step toward more flexible and widely applicable virtual try-on systems.

88. 【2610.39639】Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39639

作者：Khai Le-Duc,Nguyen Kim Hai Bui,An Ngo,Nam D. Hoang,Yueqi Song,Jiarui Liu,Thai Quoc Hoang,Fang Wu,Chris Ngo,Terry Jingchen Zhang,Mona T. Diab,Ran Xu,Silvio Savarese,Xiao-Ming Wu

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

关键词：Vision-language models, individual judgments, Vision-language, model, spanning individual judgments

备注： Preprint, 150 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object. To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%, but reveals a further difficulty: its answers about the most common colors remain inconsistent with its own per-color counts. Supplying those counts as text improves its judgments, showing that recovering a property does not mean using it consistently. Reasoning, scaling, and added visual cues each improve individual judgments, but none makes exact answers reliable. To locate the difficulty, we probe Qwen3.5-27B: exact per-color counts remain recoverable at the language model's input, yet the model's answers rarely recover them (65.0% for the probe vs. 3.0% for the model). Image-removal controls further show that some apparent successes require no visual evidence. These findings motivate evaluating 3D reasoning by exact correctness, consistent use, and image dependence, rather than accuracy alone. Code and dataset are publicly available: this https URL

89. 【2610.39633】Intrinsic Distribution Matching

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39633

作者：Deyuan Liu,Yansen Han,Kaiwen Zheng,Jun Xie,Jiacheng Liu,Zhenglin Cheng,Peng Sun,Jintao Zhang,Jianguo Li,Tao Lin

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

关键词：One-step and few-step, generation must accurately, opportunities for refinement, accurately render, render the details

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. A decomposition of the reverse-KL field into a Gaussian moment component and a non-Gaussian residual identifies statistics that can be constrained explicitly. We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder. Experiments use full-parameter and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning on Z-Image-Turbo 6B and Qwen-Image 20B. At two network evaluations, IDM reaches 94.25% and 90.20% on Chinese and English LongText-Bench, the highest scores among the compared methods at this budget. Controlled ablations show gains from the added moment loss, while generator EMA features perform competitively with an external DINOv2 encoder across the five reported metrics. Code is available at this https URL.

90. 【2610.39619】FutureWorld: A Plug-and-Play Causal Next-State Predictor for Interactive Video World Exploration

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39619

作者：Guangyuan Li,Kelu Yao,Shuolin Xu,Xinlei Yu,Wei Xing,Lei Zhao,Peng-Tao Jiang,Xiaogang Xu,Xiaobin Hu

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：follow user actions, follow user, maintaining scene consistency, maintaining scene, reuse generated latents

备注： 17 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at this https URL.

91. 【2610.39617】UniTele: Learning Device-Conditioned Degradations for Unified Smartphone Telephoto Super-Resolution

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39617

作者：Yuchen Zhang,Aojie Li,Wei Cheng,Xianfang Zeng,Runxing Liu,haixin hao,Gang YU,Xiaoyun Yuan

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：mobile phones suffers, conventional handcrafted pipelines, suffers from complex, conventional handcrafted, Super-telephoto imaging

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Super-telephoto imaging on mobile phones suffers from complex, device-dependent degradations that are poorly captured by conventional handcrafted pipelines. Collecting large-scale aligned training pairs across different phones and diverse scenes, however, is both costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study whether device-specific degradations can be learned from only a small number of physical captures and transferred for training a unified super-resolution (SR) model. Our key idea is to factor degradation learning into two learnable components: one captures the device-specific imaging characteristics under well-resolved conditions, while the other captures the additional information loss and artifacts that arise in super-telephoto imaging. We build a paired benchmark across three phone brands (Huawei, Apple, and vivo) by photographing the same content at two display sizes and zoom settings. The larger displayed image is captured at the phone's maximum optical zoom setting, while the smaller image is photographed directly at the phone's highest native zoom setting through the phone's native imaging pipeline. The benchmark contains 519 training and 60 held-out pairs. We use the benchmark to learn device-specific degradation, then apply it to external images to synthesize thousands of additional pairs to train our UniTele SR model. Relative to the pretrained Qwen and FLUX backbones before adaptation, the full UniTele training recipe substantially improves paired restoration fidelity and perceptual similarity on the held-out benchmark and yields markedly more stable and visually faithful restorations.

92. 【2610.39609】DiFuse: Fusing Native Diffusion Representations for Spatial Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39609

作者：Ruixin Fan,Weining Wang,Jiahui Sun,Tailai Chen,Jing Liu

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：routinely condition generation, remains largely asymmetric, capabilities remains largely, jointly support visual, representations routinely condition

备注： 20 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Unified multimodal models (UMMs) jointly support visual understanding and image generation, yet information flow between these two capabilities remains largely asymmetric: understanding representations routinely condition generation, whereas generative representations are rarely reused for multimodal reasoning. In this work, we investigate whether intermediate representations from a UMM's native diffusion branch can enhance spatial reasoning without compromising general multimodal understanding. We propose DiFuse, which selectively incorporates intermediate diffusion representations into the understanding pathway of UMMs. Through systematic layer-wise analysis, we identify which diffusion representations are most informative and where they can be integrated with minimal interference to semantic processing. Guided by these findings, DiFuse spatially aligns diffusion features with visual tokens and injects them into selected multimodal decoder layers via residual fusion. Extensive experiments on UniWorld-V1 show that, DiFuse consistently improves spatial reasoning over a matched SFT baseline while maintaining broadly comparable performance on general multimodal benchmarks. Further analyses show that these gains depend critically on the choice of diffusion representations, injection positions, and the preservation of spatial correspondence between diffusion features and visual tokens. Results on OmniGen2 further demonstrate the transferability of DiFuse across unified multimodal architectures. Overall, our findings show that native diffusion representations can provide complementary spatial cues for multimodal reasoning when selectively integrated in a structure-preserving manner.

93. 【2610.39602】Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Editing in Vision-Language Models

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39602

作者：Malvina Nikandrou,Georgios Pantazopoulos,Ioannis Konstas,Alessandro Suglia

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

关键词：recognize culture-specific concepts, underrepresented regions, Current Vision-Language Models, recognize culture-specific, knowledge

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently fail to recognize culture-specific concepts, especially from underrepresented regions. Effectively injecting this long-tail knowledge into existing models remains a challenge. In this work, we investigate knowledge editing as a targeted alternative by introducing CulturalBind, a benchmark comprising 3.2K images of 1K concepts from 6 domains, designed to evaluate culture-aware cross-modal knowledge as well as concept-level knowledge editing in VLMs. Pre-edit evaluation reveals that textual and visual knowledge is decoupled: models often demonstrate text-based knowledge of cultural concepts but fail to identify them from images. We then evaluate editing methods in single and sequential scenarios. Although current methods successfully correct individual visual recognition errors, they exhibit low cross-modal portability, failing to integrate edits into the model's broader parametric knowledge. Furthermore, performance degrades rapidly under sequential editing, highlighting the need for comprehensive adaptation approaches that better consolidate multimodal knowledge over time.

94. 【2610.39601】GC-LIF: Spiking Group-Equivariant Neural Network With Group-Coupled Membrane Dynamics

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39601

作者：Nhan Trong Luu,Duong Trung Luu,Thang Cong Truong

类目：Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Spiking neural networks, acquire rotation invariance, promise event-driven, low-power inference, data augmentation

备注： Under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Spiking neural networks (SNNs) promise event-driven, low-power inference, but on vision tasks they still acquire rotation invariance only through data augmentation. Group-equivariant CNNs build such symmetries into the architecture, yet a faithful spiking analogue is missing: a leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron placed after a $G$-equivariant convolution can break equivariance through its membrane recurrence. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for this not to happen. The layer is equivariant at every time step if and only if the neuron parameters $(\beta, v_{\mathrm{th}})$ are constant along the joint orbits of the group action on the (group, space) index. We solve it in closed form, and it covers any elementwise stateful neuron. Its sufficiency half specialises a known result for equivariant recurrent networks; its necessity half rules out the heterogeneous per-neuron parameters common in SNNs. The per-channel parameterisation that satisfies it, Group-Coupled LIF (GC-LIF), is combined with $p4$ and $p4m$-equivariant convolutions and a spike-rate group max-pool into SGE-Net. On MNIST, KMNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, evaluating each checkpoint on the clean test set and all its group-transformed copies, SGE-Net trained without rotations is invariant under $C_4$ and $D_4$ and outperforms a plain SNN trained with rotations in nine of ten dataset-group pairs, whereas non-equivariant baselines lose up to $72$ percentage points in the worst case. Operator-level tests confirm the theory before and after training, and an analytical estimate places SGE-Net at $1.7\times$ the arithmetic energy of a standard CNN and $2.3\times$ below its ANN counterpart at eight time steps.

95. 【2610.39592】Operator-Aware Posterior Sampling for Multivariate Weather Downscaling

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39592

作者：Carlo Saccardi,Rudolf Saathof,Geethu Joseph,Justin Dauwels

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：reconstructing high-resolution meteorological, Statistical downscaling, high-resolution meteorological fields, task of reconstructing, Bayesian inverse problem

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Statistical downscaling is the task of reconstructing high-resolution meteorological fields from coarse inputs. A principled approach formulates downscaling as a Bayesian inverse problem, using a diffusion prior over high-resolution fields and incorporating the coarse field only at inference through a likelihood. This decouples the prior from the coarse source, allowing one pretrained model to adapt to different sources. However, two challenges limit this flexibility: (1) when coarse and target fields come from different reanalysis systems, no fixed coarsening operator can capture their relationship; and (2) guidance gradients can differ by orders of magnitude across variables, making a single guidance strength ineffective. This paper addresses both challenges within the guidance loop, leaving the prior unchanged. We learn the forward operator from paired data and normalize the gradient per channel. We show that this normalization corresponds to steepest descent under a block-max norm, allowing a single guidance strength across variables. Our code is publicly available at this https URL.

96. 【2610.39585】actoHand: Learning Geometry-Based Dense Hand-Surface Interaction Fields from Video

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39585

作者：Ziheng Xi,Weibo Li,Jiayi Yu,Sipeng Zheng,Wanpeng Zhang,Haiweng Xu,Hao Luo,Chuan Mao,Zongqing Lu

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Understanding how humans, hand surface, humans interact, representation of physical, world requires

备注： 23 pages, including references and appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding how humans interact with the world requires a representation of physical interactions at the hand surface. Tactile sensing captures these interactions, but collecting tactile data at scale requires specialized hardware. We introduce TactoHand, a model that predicts three dense hand-surface interaction fields---contact, proximity, and 3D force---from monocular video. We derive geometry-based contact and proximity labels and motion-derived force labels from eligible training data within a curated collection spanning approximately 50 million source frames. TactoHand uses a temporal transformer to aggregate visual evidence across frames, while three learned queries decode the corresponding hand-surface fields. A differentiable physics layer further constrains force predictions using observed object motion. Across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, TactoHand improves contact and proximity estimation over prior methods. In addition, physics supervision reduces position and rotation errors in motion rollouts, and the predicted contact and proximity fields improve downstream hand-object reconstruction. Together, these results show a scalable, low-cost path to learning hand-surface interaction fields without collecting tactile measurements. Code will be released at this https URL.

97. 【2610.39584】DOSE: Dominance-Guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39584

作者：Tushir Sahu,Hideaki Hayashi,Hajime Nagahara

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：estimation commonly relies, severity estimation commonly, Medical severity estimation, Sparse Relative Annotations, Ordinal Severity Estimation

备注： Accepted to WACV 2027. 8 pages, 4 figures. Adjust the counts if you add the supplementary material

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Medical severity estimation commonly relies on absolute grade annotations, which are fundamentally ordinal, yet existing methods often treat the grades as independent categories. Learning-to-rank methods, which can be trained using relative annotations based on severity comparisons of image pairs, can provide continuous severity rankings but cannot directly predict discrete severity grades. We propose Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations (DOSE), a framework for learning ordinal medical severity from sparse pairwise comparisons without using absolute annotations. DOSE aggregates the observed comparisons through a global comparison graph to estimate a dominance score for each image. Differences between dominance scores set cumulative margins in the embedding space, so that pairs with larger estimated severity differences are separated more strongly, and also generate pseudo-pairs that supervise a scalar severity head alongside the observed comparisons. The learned continuous severity axis is converted into discrete grades via label-free score calibration, with tie-anchored segmentation as the main calibration method. In the experiment, DOSE consistently outperformed pairwise-ranking baselines on ACNE04, IDRiD, and LIMUC under different pair budgets. Code is available at this https URL

98. 【2610.39553】BEACON: Distilled Begin/End-Aware Structured Decoding for Continuous Sign Language Segmentation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39553

作者：Guohou Zhang,Kalin Stefanov

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：segmentation-based continuous sign, segmentation-based continuous, untrimmed video, lexical units, continuous sign language

备注： Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 12 pages, 4 figures, including supplementary material

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In segmentation-based continuous sign language recognition, an untrimmed video is first partitioned into lexical units; segmentation is therefore a means to an end---downstream recognition. However, segmenters are usually judged by local boundary detection rather than by the quality of the lexical segments and the recognition they enable. We present BEACON, a begin/end-aware segmenter that combines four-class Outside/Begin/Inside/End (BIOE) labeling, constrained Viterbi decoding over eight legal transitions, and boundary knowledge distilled from a binary teacher into a shared student. Under strict no-cut evaluation with validation-based model selection, BEACON improves segment-F1 by 14.58/14.59 points and boundary-F1 by 2.17/1.22 points, and reduces the downstream word error rate (WER) by 9.10/4.15 points relative to the state-of-the-art in the PHOENIX-14/BSL Corpus. To examine which segmentation metric better reflects downstream recognition, we evaluated five distinct architecture families. Segment-F1 aligns more consistently with lower WER than boundary-F1 in both corpora (Spearman $\rho=-1.0/-0.9$ versus $-0.9/-0.8$). These results support evaluating sign language segmentation in terms of segment quality and downstream recognition utility rather than local boundary accuracy alone.

99. 【2610.39551】Comprehensive empirical evaluation of feature extractors in computer vision

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39551

作者：Murat Isik

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：Binary Robust Invariant, Invariant Scalable Keypoints, Robust Invariant Scalable, Binary Robust Independent, Accurate Invariant Scalable

备注： 26 Pages, 9 Figures, 6 Tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Feature detection and matching are fundamental components in computer vision, underpinning a broad spectrum of applications. This study offers a comprehensive evaluation of traditional feature detections and descriptors, analyzing methods such as Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF), Binary Robust Independent Elementary Features (BRIEF), Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB), Binary Robust Invariant Scalable Keypoints (BRISK), KAZE, Accelerated KAZE (AKAZE), Fast Retina Keypoint (FREAK), Dense and Accurate Invariant Scalable descriptor for Yale (DAISY), Features from Accelerated Segment Test (FAST), and STAR. Each feature extractor was assessed based on its architectural design and complexity, focusing on how these factors influence computational efficiency and robustness under various transformations. Utilizing the Image Matching Challenge Photo Tourism 2020 dataset, which includes over 1.5 million images, the study identifies the FAST algorithm as the most efficient detector when paired with the ORB descriptor and Brute-Force (BF) matcher, offering the fastest feature extraction and matching process. ORB is notably effective on affine transformed and brightened images, while AKAZE excels in conditions involving blurring, fisheye distortion, image rotation, and perspective distortions. Through more than 2 million comparisons, the study highlights the feature extractors that demonstrate superior resilience across various conditions, including rotation, scaling, blurring, brightening, affine transformations, perspective distortions, fisheye distortion, and salt-and-pepper noise

100. 【2610.39539】ROAD: Modern Adversarial Training for Simple One-Step Distillation at Scale

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39539

作者：Xiaoou Li,Shan You,Tao Huang

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：turns pretrained diffusion, distillation turns pretrained, One-step distillation turns, pretrained diffusion models, One-step Adversarial Distillation

备注： 37 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:One-step distillation turns pretrained diffusion models into fast generators, but strong results often require substantial training machinery and compute. Pure adversarial distillation offers a simpler route, yet has struggled at modern text-to-image scale. To address this limitation, we propose ROAD (Representation-grounded One-step Adversarial Distillation), a one-stage framework that distills text-to-image models with one adversarial objective and a lightweight representation-space critic. First, we replace the classical convolutional head with a Lipschitz-controlled Transformer head with token-level text conditioning, which matches the semantic tokens of modern visual encoders. Second, we observed a fixed random feature mixing leads to long-horizon degradation. We attribute it to generator-critic co-adaptation around one realization-specific view, and periodically re-draw the mixing to keep the randomization effective. Third, for our dense and vector-valued logits, we introduce Jacobian R1 which penalizes the full input-logit Jacobian, overcoming pooled R1's limitation of neglecting most of logit sensitivities. A single adversarial objective then suffices: in one step, ROAD reaches 11.03 FID on SDXL and 13.73 on SD3.5-M on COCO-10K, surpassing the multi-step teachers at a fraction of distribution matching's training compute.

101. 【2610.39534】MOSAIC-Flow: Orthogonal-Axis and Status-Conditioned Fusion for Missing-Sequence Completion in Brain Tumor MRI

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39534

作者：Pengli Zhu,Zhihao Peng,Yixuan Yuan

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：brain tumor characterization, comprehensive brain tumor, obscure sequence-specific contrast, three-dimensional tumor detail, fine-grained three-dimensional tumor

备注： 5 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Missing-sequence completion is important for comprehensive brain tumor characterization, but cross-modal fusion can obscure sequence-specific contrast and lose fine-grained three-dimensional tumor detail. To address this challenge, we introduce Modality-aware Orthogonal-axis Status-conditioned Attentive Integration for Completion (MOSAIC-Flow), a unified framework for missing-sequence completion that learns a target-conditioned velocity field while keeping the seven acquired volumes fixed throughout the transport. Specifically, modality-aware stems independently encode each sequence, and orthogonal-axis refinement captures axial, coronal, and sagittal dependencies while retaining the three-dimensional representation. Status-conditioned prototype fusion uses compact modality and availability tokens to route and modulate pooled queries from the fused visual representation, enabling target-adaptive conditioning without dense voxel-to-voxel attention. A conditional flow matching objective transports target-channel noise toward the single missing sequence, while four Heun trajectories are averaged to produce the completion. Evaluation across structural, diffusion, and contrast-enhanced MRI in UCSF-PDGM demonstrates consistent whole-brain and tumor-region fidelity across all eight single-target completion tasks, with the strongest performance on structural sequences. Code is available at this https URL.

102. 【2610.39530】MorphSIG: Subject-Driven Image Generation via Decoupled Anchoring and Feature Transport

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39530

作者：Hailong Yan,Yongrui Zhang,Xiangtao Zhang,Le Zhang

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：reformulates subject-driven image, pseudo-video feature transport, Guided Feature Transport, Progressive Decoupled Anchoring, Pseudo-flow Guided Feature

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We propose MorphSIG, a training-free framework that reformulates subject-driven image generation (SIG) as pseudo-video feature transport. MorphSIG contains two core modules: Progressive Decoupled Anchoring, which uses frequency-domain decoupling and structural scrambling during early denoising to break structural locking and enable a gradual transition from free composition to identity alignment; and Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport, which constructs a latent-space pseudo-flow field to mimic Image-to-Video temporal coherence and transport subject semantics precisely. To address stylistic homogeneity and the lack of ground truth in existing benchmarks, we further introduce a benchmark with diverse stylized subjects. Extensive experiments show that MorphSIG significantly improves pose diversity and subject fidelity over baselines without additional training. Overall, MorphSIG bridges static generation and dynamic propagation, providing a cost-effective paradigm for high-fidelity subject consistency.

103. 【2610.39520】BRIDGE: Learning Brain-Gut Metabolic Evidence for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39520

作者：Pengli Zhu,Ruxi Chang,Tianliang Yao,Yu Jiang,Shengyuan Liu,Yiyang Lin,Xiaoyi Duan,Shuang Wu,Yixuan Yuan, theAlzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Alzheimer disease, largely analyze cerebral, analyze cerebral glucose, cerebral glucose metabolism, existing models largely

备注： 10 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis may benefit from gut metabolic information associated with brain-gut interactions, yet existing models largely analyze cerebral glucose metabolism alone. Although whole-body fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) can provide paired brain-gut observations, routine brain examinations rarely include gut imaging, limiting direct use of this information for diagnosis. In this paper, we present BRIDGE (Brain and Gut Representation Integration via Distribution-Guided Enhancement), a two-stage framework for transferring brain-gut metabolic knowledge to brain-only diagnosis. Specifically, BRIDGE integrates a conditional brain-to-gut latent transport module and a disease-evidence-guided cerebral pathway to capture subject-specific cross-organ correspondence and disease-relevant cerebral representations. For the cerebral pathway, a large language model (LLM) helps organize literature-derived descriptors into human-approved semantic anchors that guide feature learning. Additionally, we introduce a counterfactual-guided residual fusion mechanism, which uses matched and non-matched virtual-gut evidence to supervise a confidence gate and dynamically regulate the contribution of transported cross-organ information. At inference, BRIDGE exploits complementary gut-related context using brain PET alone, without measured gut PET. Extensive experiments across public and private cohorts demonstrate that BRIDGE outperforms brain-only and cross-organ baselines, achieving AUC gains of 6.0% and 5.2% over its brain-only counterpart for CN/MCI and CN/AD diagnosis, respectively. Notably, its ability to transfer complementary brain-gut metabolic context while preserving brain PET as the sole inference input highlights its potential for clinically practical diagnosis. Our code is available at this https URL.

104. 【2610.39517】FFAI: Flow Matching with Feedback Training and Adaptive Initialization for CT Reconstruction

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39517

作者：Jigang Duan,Heran Wang,Genwei Ma,Xing Zhao

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：limited measurement information, distinct degradation mechanisms, involve distinct degradation, pose reconstruction challenges, reconstruction challenges due

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Although low-dose, sparse-view, and limited-angle CT involve distinct degradation mechanisms, all three pose reconstruction challenges due to limited measurement information and can therefore be addressed within a unified framework. In iterative image restoration with flow matching, prediction errors may cause inference states to deviate from the prescribed training path, while a fixed initialization may be unsuitable for inputs with varying degradation severity. We propose a unified conditional flow matching method that conditions on the initial reconstruction and combines feedback-aware training with degradation-adaptive initialization. During training, a teacher network simulates inference updates to generate shifted states, from which a student network learns to recover high-quality reference images, improving its ability to handle prediction errors. During inference, the starting time is selected based on the noise level or extent of missing projection data, and the noise added to the initial state is adjusted accordingly to adapt the starting point to the input. Experiments on public benchmark datasets show that the proposed method achieves better quantitative results than the compared methods across all three reconstruction tasks, effectively suppressing noise and artifacts while preserving anatomical structures and details.

105. 【2610.39516】Robust LIDAR Sensor-to-Sensor Domain Generalization via Accumulated-Point Scene Completion

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39516

作者：Christoph B Rist,Larissa T Triess,Markus Enzweiler,Dariu M Gavrila

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：LIDAR, segmentation, real-world LIDAR exhibits, LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific, performance

备注： 2026 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study domain generalization for LIDAR semantic segmentation. Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on 3D point clouds, yet real-world LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific sampling patterns that hinder transfer across datasets. In many applications, performance on completely unseen sensors is crucial. A model should preferably work on a new setup without prior access to its data or labels. To this end, we introduce a source-only training scheme that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective. We aggregate source-domain scans into a simple world model and use it as the supervision signal, replacing single-scan standard segmentation training. A key property of our approach is that it does not alter the input scan. During training and testing the network consumes the same single-frame LIDAR input, only the supervision signal is enriched via the occupancy objective. At deployment, there is no runtime overhead as the auxiliary head can be dropped for pure segmentation, or kept to obtain scene completion alongside semantic segmentation. In an experimental evaluation across distinct LIDAR datasets, we demonstrate that a model's generalization to new domains can be significantly affected by how it is supervised. In certain setups, performance on unseen domains improves without any explicit domain adaptation (no target scans, no target labels, no sensor priors) and without prediction refinement. At the same time, our method maintains competitive source-domain segmentation performance and incurs no additional inference cost.

106. 【2610.39505】Agent-Wise Test-Time Normalization for Camera-Based Cooperative Perception with Corrupted Collaborators

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39505

作者：Yu Wang,Shaohua Wang,Yicheng Li,Kecheng Sun

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

关键词：Intermediate-fusion cooperative perception, vehicle detect objects, Intermediate-fusion cooperative, fusing features shared, cooperative perception

备注： 11 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Intermediate-fusion cooperative perception lets a vehicle detect objects beyond its own field of view by fusing features shared by nearby agents. When only a collaborator's cameras are degraded by fog, motion blur or exposure errors, the features it shares drift away from the training distribution while the ego input stays clean, and cooperation can become worse than not cooperating at all. Test-time batch-normalization adaptation, the standard training-free remedy, estimates statistics over the pooled batch of all agents and therefore normalizes both the clean ego and the corrupted collaborator with a mixture of two distributions. We show that this mixing harms even the clean ego: when the ego shares BN statistics with a corrupted collaborator, its detection from its own features drops by 3.58 to 6.68 AP@0.5 points although its cameras are untouched. We propose AgentNorm, an agent-wise test-time normalization that i) estimates the normalization statistics of every collaborator from its own current observation and ii) anchors the ego to its source statistics, so that the ego path remains exactly the original model. AgentNorm has no learnable parameters, needs no gradients or labels, is independent of the order of test frames, and runs locally on each agent without changing the transmitted features. On camera-based OPV2V with four fusion checkpoints and collaborator-only corruptions, AgentNorm raises AP@0.5 under severity-5 fog from 29.42-37.25 to 43.32-58.86 and outperforms pooled normalization by 5.53-12.94 points under fog and motion blur, at an extra latency of 2.3 ms per frame. On the real-world DAIR-V2X-C dataset, it outperforms pooled normalization in all ten infrastructure-corruption settings. We also report the cases it does not fix: occlusion, which removes image content rather than shifting feature statistics, and the case in which all agents share the same shift.

107. 【2610.39483】Does Federated Training Degrade Explainability? A Comparative Analysis of Grad-CAM Faithfulness in Centralized vs. Federated Deepfake Detection

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39483

作者：Muhammad Uzair Shahid,Muhammad Zabil Mehboob

类目：Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：realistic synthetic media, scale requires training, Automated detection, synthetic media, multiple organizations

备注： 10 Pages, 3 figures, Muhammad Uzair Shahid and Muhammad Zabil Mehboob contributed equally to this work

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated detection has become the essential safeguard against realistic synthetic media, but deploying it at scale requires training on sensitive data from multiple organizations, putting privacy and the transparency demanded by forensic review in direct conflict. Federated learning resolves the privacy side by sharing only model updates rather than raw data, but whether this comes at the cost of trustworthy gradient-based explanations, which analysts rely on to decide whether or not to trust a flagged clip, has not been studied. We present the systematic study of Grad-CAM explanation faithfulness under federated deepfake detection, evaluating an EfficientNet-B4 detector on FaceForensics++ across five federated clients under varying degrees of data heterogeneity. We find that the relationship between federation and explanation quality is non-monotonic: at near-IID (Independent and Identically Distributed Data) and moderate heterogeneity, federated models match or exceed the faithfulness of a centralized baseline, but at extreme heterogeneity, explanations break down entirely, becoming spatially incoherent and, on average, causally misleading. This degradation is not a general cost of federated training but a threshold effect tied to client heterogeneity, and we offer practical guidance for identifying when privacy-preserving deepfake detection can be deployed safely and when its explanations can no longer be trusted. Code and data partitions are available for reproducibility.

108. 【2610.39478】Regional Anchor Routing for Multi-Object Motion Transfer

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39478

作者：Yuze Li,Fuchen Long,Xinlong Sun,Cheng Yan,Xinyu Zhang,Xi Chen

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：multiple reference videos, motion, requires a model, video Diffusion Transformer, motion transfer requires

备注： Project Page: [this https URL](https://ethan-li123.github.io/RART_page/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Compositional motion transfer requires a model to extract motions from multiple reference videos, and apply each motion to a user-specified object in one target scene. Existing methods normally struggle to reliably assign different reference motions to the correct target objects, thus a motion intended for one object may affect another. Meanwhile, some motion-specific tuning approaches are still facing another issue: they must run a new optimization whenever the reference video changes, making repeated transfers inefficient. To address these limitations, we propose RART, a framework that unifies object-wise motion extraction, target-region anchoring, and frame-aligned injection into a frozen video Diffusion Transformer for multi-object motion transfer. For each reference motion, RART extracts temporally ordered features from the masked reference video, and then conditions them on the target first-frame mask to form mask-anchored motion tokens. Frame-aligned motion cross-attention allows each generated frame to read only the motion tokens at the corresponding time slots, composing all object motions in one denoising process. During training, a motion-attention routing loss encourages each target region to attend to its corresponding motion tokens and reduces interference between objects. Therefore, RART can handle novel reference-target combinations without per-video optimization. Experiments show that RART achieves accurate motion preservation, efficient inference, and strong compositional generalization.

109. 【2610.39467】Calibrating Attention-Based Token Pruning for Efficient Multi-Image Synthesis in UMMs

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39467

作者：Zimeng Wu,Qijian Tian,Penghui Du,Changqian Yu,Jiaxin Chen,Yunhong Wang

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Unified Multimodal Models, Unified Multimodal, Multimodal Models, enable powerful multi-image, long visual contexts

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) enable powerful multi-image synthesis but incur substantial computation from long visual contexts. While token pruning offers a direct route to accelerating inference, existing methods are primarily adapted from understanding tasks, suffering from insufficient reference image exploration, confused conditional guidance, and pooling-induced ambiguity that degrades generation quality. To address these issues, we propose CATP, the first training-free context-compression method tailored to UMM generation, which \textbf{C}alibrates the discrepancies of general \textbf{A}ttention-based \textbf{T}oken \textbf{P}runing for better quality-efficiency trade-off. Concretely, building on independent layer-wise pruning during denoising, we introduce Guidance-Consistent Pruning (GCP) to synchronize pruning decisions across conditioning branches, and a Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric (TCAM) that derives a theoretically grounded second-order correction for pooling-induced bias. In addition, a Fast Scoring Operator (FSO) fuses the calibration into tiled online Softmax to reduce pruning cost. Extensive experiments across representative UMMs and benchmarks demonstrate that CATP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art token-reduction methods, achieving up to 2.09$\times$ attention-core speedup.

110. 【2610.39441】PathCowork: Learning from real-world pathology practice to build AI copilots

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39441

作者：Sheng Wang,Jialu Yao,Maria V. Rossi,Shunsuke Koga,Esther Baranov,MacLean P. Nasrallah,Songhao Li,Jonathan Xu,Wei Du,Cindy McGrath,Timothy Chao,Anne Wang,Zhaohai Yang,Daniel Akuma,Selemon M. Walle,Olga Pozdnyakova,Edward B. Lee,Zahra Alipour,Annapurna Saksena,Rashmi Tondon,Nikolina Dioufa,David E. Elder,George J. Netto,Xiaowei Xu,Zhi Huang

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：answers doctors record, doctors record, answers doctors, interpret the evidence, evidence to reach

备注： 56 pages, including supplementary information. Code, models and demonstration videos: [this https URL](https://github.com/zhihuanglab/PathCowork)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Medical AI learns from the answers doctors record, but rarely from how they interpret the evidence to reach them. Here we introduce PathCowork, a framework that turns pathologists' narrated examinations into supervision for visual grounding and procedures that guide diagnostic AI agents. Synchronized gaze, narration and navigation link visual findings to the process of interpreting them. Across 48 sessions from 16 pathologists, the platform captured 1,028 minutes of slide review. Using these data, we trained PathCowork-1T for server deployment and PathCowork-27B for local deployment, with improved visual grounding. Across five organ-specific evaluations, agents combining this grounding with recorded diagnostic procedures achieved primary task scores averaging 17.9 and 24.1 percentage points higher than Claude Code and Codex, respectively, with shorter processing times and lower inference costs. Compared to the state-of-the-art multiple-instance learning AIs, the PathCowork agent-proposed regions achieved higher prostate-grading scores with limited slide labels. PathCowork can also help construct pathology AI benchmarks where questions derived from the recordings identified difficulties in recognizing viewing context and rejecting inapplicable premises. In summary, PathCowork proposes a new paradigm to scale up the data collection and train pathology AI through transparent reasoning from diagnostic sessions, opening a path towards systems that learn directly from routine clinical practice.

111. 【2610.39423】FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39423

作者：Hina Otake,Shinei Arakawa,Keitaro Tanaka,Yoshihiro Fukuhara,Hirokatsu Kataoka,Shigeo Morishima

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)

关键词：Supervised Metric Learning, Formula-Driven Supervised Learning, existing methods cast, Formula-Driven Supervised Metric, Supervised Learning

备注： Accepted to WACV 2027. 24 pages (11 main + 13 supplementary). Project page: [this https URL](https://shineiarakawa.github.io/fdsml/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. We propose Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning (FDSML), which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters beyond discrete class labels. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. This objective trains embeddings to respect parameter-derived relative similarity orderings. Experiments show that FDSML improves transferability to image retrieval while remaining competitive on downstream classification and improving robustness under several corruption settings. On ResNet-50, Recall@1 improves from 65.6% to 74.0% on Stanford Online Products and from 56.2% to 78.4% on Stanford Cars over FDSL pre-training. These results suggest that parameter-derived relational supervision provides a stronger synthetic pre-training signal than label-based classification for transfer beyond recognition.

112. 【2610.39419】Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39419

作者：Guizhen Chen,Weiwen Xu,Wotao Yin,Anh Tuan Luu,Hou Pong Chan

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

关键词：recognize visual content, large language models, multiple steps, content yet struggle, struggle to reason

备注： 20 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this gap. We introduce ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks in which the scene, question, and answer are fixed and only the reference varies. Results show that task-matched references improve accuracy by up to 25\%, while mismatched references provide little benefit or even hurt performance. These findings identify the reference gap as a bottleneck distinct from visual perception and show that constructing task-appropriate visual references can serve as a training-free visual skill for improving multimodal reasoning.

113. 【2610.39416】Decoding Geometry, Not Tokens: Efficient VLMs for Robot Affordance and Trajectory Prediction

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39416

作者：Akila Ayanthi,Darshana Priyasad,Tharindu Fernando,Dimity Miller,Sridha Sridharan,Clinton Fookes,Peyman Moghadam

类目：Robotics (cs.RO); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：geometry problem, move is fundamentally, fundamentally a geometry, Predicting, prediction

备注： IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Predicting where to grasp and how to move is fundamentally a geometry problem. Vision-language models treat it as language generation instead. They tokenize spatial coordinates into text and decode them autoregressively. This mechanism ignores spatial structure and truncates continuous precision. Errors compound across coordinate tokens during decoding. In this paper, we show that compact off-the-shelf VLMs with 0.5-2B parameters already encode rich spatial information in their intermediate hidden states. Autoregressive decoding is the dominant bottleneck for trajectory prediction, while affordance prediction depends additionally on feature depth and decoder architecture. We expose the latent spatial information with a lightweight, geometry-compatible prediction head that attaches to a frozen backbone. It reads features from an intermediate hidden layer, conditions a learned query on the task instruction and refines it via cross-attention over the visual tokens to regress affordance boxes and trajectory waypoints directly as continuous values, without modifying the backbone. We evaluate on ShareRobot-Bench and AGD20K. Our 2B variant reduces trajectory error by over 60% and improves ShareRobot-Bench affordance mAP by 85% relative to the autoregressive baseline. It approaches RoboBrain on trajectory prediction (0.251 vs 0.191 DFD) at 3.8x higher throughput. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for instruction-conditioned 2D geometric prediction.
