210. 【2610.38042】Can Event Detectors Leave the Broadcast Camera? Evidence from Tennis

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38042

作者：David Soeiro-Vuong,Andre-Louis Rochet

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

关键词：statistics are derived, easy to confuse, tennis statistics, monocular video, phone and court-level

备注： 16 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Benchmark, evaluator and frozen predictions: [this https URL](https://github.com/David-dsv/tennis-bounce-hit-benchmark)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Ball bounces and racket hits are the events from which tennis statistics are derived, and on monocular video the two are easy to confuse. We release a benchmark of 345 bounce and hit annotations at frame level on eight clips that mix broadcast, fixed elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, with a frozen development and test split, a confusion-aware matcher, clip-level bootstrap intervals and a blind second annotation of three clips. On it we score supervised precise spotters with published broadcast weights, two zero-shot vision-language models, and RallyArb, an arbitration layer over a ball track and player poses that fits no parameter on event labels. The supervised spotters score near-perfectly on broadcast footage and almost nothing on phone and court-level footage, where the pooled bounce F1 of E2E-Spot is 0.130. RallyArb keeps a bounce F1 above 0.8 on the three phone and court-level clips, two of which were used to tune it, and finds 8 of 11 bounces on the held-out one, but it places hits too far from the contact frame to match human timing. The vision-language models detect events on every viewpoint and miss the contact frame by about 0.1 s. Fine-tuned leave-one-clip-out from its broadcast weights, the spotter reaches about 0.8 bounce F1 on two phone and court-level clips and stays at 0.2 on a grazing phone angle. The annotations, the evaluator and the frozen predictions of every scored row are released.

211. 【2610.38013】Where Can We Fool the Model's Mind? Response-Guided Semantic Probing and Adaptive Routing for Transferable Attacks on Black-Box MLLMs

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38013

作者：Ahmed Abdelnaby,Mohamed Elmahallawy

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Large Language Models, Multimodal Large Language, Language Models, Large Language, ground language

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) ground language in visual evidence, yet their semantic reasoning can be exploited through transferable black-box adversarial attacks. Existing attacks typically allocate perturbations using surrogate-model saliency, which may not reflect how an unseen MLLM semantically interprets or relies on different image regions. We introduce VISTA (Vulnerability-Informed Semantic Transfer Attacks), a black-box framework that identifies semantically vulnerable visual regions from an MLLM's responses without access to gradients, logits, parameters, or internal representations. VISTA supports two attack settings: (i) VISTA-Proxy, a pure-transfer setting that probes an open-source MLLM and transfers the resulting adversarial examples to unseen commercial MLLMs without querying them; and (ii) VISTA-Victim, a query-assisted setting that probes the target MLLM to capture model-specific semantic vulnerabilities. VISTA builds an Uncertainty-Based Multimodal Behavior (UBMB) map from response drift, conflict, misleading, and semantic shifts, then uses entropy-adaptive Sinkhorn routing and a surrogate ensemble to focus perturbations on vulnerable regions. Across GPT-5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, VISTA achieves up to 97 % attack success rate (ASR) while maintaining a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 30 dB. Notably, VISTA-Proxy achieves up to 93 % ASR without querying the final victim, demonstrating that response-derived semantic vulnerability can enable effective transfer across heterogeneous MLLMs.

212. 【2610.38007】Frequency-Adaptive Gaussian Grids for Efficient Image Representation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38007

作者：Anatolii Evdokimov,Stavros Diolatzis,Bingxuan Li,Akshay Jindal,Patsorn Sangkloy,Qi Sun

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Graphics (cs.GR)

关键词：increasingly higher-resolution images, powerful tool, tool to mitigate, mitigate the demand, demand for increasingly

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Neural representation has emerged as a powerful tool to mitigate the demand for increasingly higher-resolution images. However, a fundamental trade-off remains between structured (e.g., feature grids, which offer spatial consistency) and unstructured (e.g., 2D Gaussians, which adaptively capture local variances) representations. This choice significantly affects how well an algorithm represents an image. Here, we present Gaussian-Grid, a hybrid neural representation that adaptively integrates structured and unstructured primitives. By dynamically partitioning computation between 2D Gaussian distributions and their attached multi-resolution feature grids based on the local frequency content, Gaussian-Grid automatically optimizes its architecture to match the underlying complexity of the target signal. We evaluate our approach using high-resolution natural images and demonstrate its applications as GPU-native dataset storage, showing $1.24$-$2.14\times$ decoding speed improvement and PCIe data traffic reduction of $23\times$-$176\times$ over JPEG + ZIP data archiving. The results show that Gaussian-Grid maintains small memory footprints while achieving high reconstruction fidelity across a variety of datasets.

213. 【2610.37983】Hierarchical Diffusion for Camera-controlled Autoregressive Video Generation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37983

作者：Kaihua Chen,Yiming Gong,Deva Ramanan,Tarasha Khurana

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：single image, address the task, Abstract, generation, time

备注： Project page: [this https URL](https://kaihua-chen.github.io/wanar_fixar/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We address the task of long-video, camera-controlled generation from a single image. The dominant autoregressive paradigm suffers from two key limitations: (1) error accumulation over time, as distant frames are conditioned on previously generated outputs rather than ground truth, leading to drift; and (2) ambiguity in how to incorporate camera control. Standard solutions to both--such as self-forcing and conditioning on explicit 6-DOF poses--either incur significant computational overhead or produce drifting scene geometries over time. We propose a simple and lightweight framework that combines autoregressive generation (WanAR) with hierarchical long-context denoising (FixAR). To enforce scene geometry remains consistent with input cameras, we draw from feed-forward novel-view synthesis and reformulate video generation as a warping-and-inpainting problem. To mitigate drift, we introduce a hierarchical denoising strategy in which different stages condition on different temporal histories. Specifically, we first generate frames conditioned on the immediate past, and then refine them using a second denoiser conditioned on a temporally subsampled long-range history to enforce global consistency. This fine-to-coarse scheme enables each generated frame to effectively condition on the full temporal context without incurring a prohibitive cost. Experiments on RealEstate10k and DL3DV demonstrate that WanAR+FixAR outperforms prior methods for camera-controlled long-video generation, producing results that are both temporally stable and consistent with input camera trajectories.

214. 【2610.37965】Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37965

作者：Marat O. Zinovev,Dmitry V. Sorokin

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：Implicit neural representation, deformable medical image, medical image registration, image registration require, Implicit neural

备注： 14 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. English-language author version of a paper presented at GraphiCon 2026, Saint Petersburg, Russia, 22-24 September 2026. Russian-language proceedings forthcoming. Related work updated for this version

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.

215. 【2610.37937】You Don't Need Aligned Representations: Knowledge Distillation via Random Prototype Spaces

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37937

作者：Hamza Etcibasi,Ramazan Gokberk Cinbis

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：widely held assumption, Prototype Knowledge Distillation, explicitly aligned feature, knowledge distillation, Random Prototype Knowledge

备注： To appear at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text plus appendices. Code: [this https URL](https://github.com/HamzaEtcibasi/RPKD)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A widely held assumption in knowledge distillation is that teacher and student representations must occupy a compatible or explicitly aligned feature space. We propose RPKD (Random Prototype Knowledge Distillation), which discards this assumption by comparing both networks against a shared bank of randomly initialized, frozen prototype vectors. Alignment is therefore carried out in an external reference space rather than in the teacher's native feature coordinates: the teacher side is projected by fixed random maps that carry no trainable parameters, and only the student adapts. Two branches handle the transfer: a logit branch aligning global prototype similarity distributions and a feature branch matching spatially-resolved prototype activation maps. Both operate within the same fixed prototype space, which can be interpreted as a random feature embedding that approximately preserves inter-sample similarity structure, so the prototype bank and the distillation objective stay unchanged across teacher-student pairs while only the input projections are instantiated per architecture. In low-category settings, decoupling the prototype vocabulary from the task label space yields richer supervision than the label space alone, an advantage absent from logit-based methods, whose supervisory signal collapses as class count shrinks. This advantage is especially relevant in real-world scenarios where the label space is typically constrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RPKD, achieving a maximum gain of +7.98% over OFA on CIFAR-100, +12.44% on ImageNet-100, and +1.28% on ImageNet-1K. Source code is available at this https URL

216. 【2610.37918】Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37918

作者：Chenfan Qu,Yachao Liang,Mingqi Fang,Jiangwei Xie,Zhenming Wang,Baoyue Zhang,Changjiang Jiang,Zheng Chang,Fanli Jin,Xuekang Zhu,Kaiwen Feng,Junchi Li,Weihong Zhang,Haoyue Wang,Chenfeng Zhang,Yinan Xia,Fangming Cui,Dong Fan,Jingjing Liu,Tianyi Zhang,Luobin Chen,Ji-Zhe Zhou,Sheng Li,Wei Wang,Bin Li,Ran He,Xinpeng Zhang,Linna Zhou,Jian Liu,Weiqiang Wang

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Real-world forgery, inherently heterogeneous, forgery is inherently, digital manipulation, Real-world

备注： Technical Report

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Real-world forgery is inherently heterogeneous: it manifests not only as digital manipulation but also as physical spoofing, and is carried not only by images but also by videos. Despite substantial progress, a unified anti-forgery foundation model covering such a broad threat spectrum remains absent. In this paper, we present Venus-DefakerOne2, which substantially extends the forensic capability boundary along both the forgery-form and media-type dimensions. Trained on tens of millions of open-source and in-house samples, it incorporates two key designs. Tide-Style-Tuning alternates LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning to balance computational efficiency, generalization, and hard-sample fitting while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Entropy-based Test Adaptation determines the optimal prediction modality by analyzing prediction entropy. Venus-DefakerOne2 achieves new state-of-the-art performance across a comprehensive suite of benchmarks, including DeepFake faces (96.7%), AI-generated images (93.3%), tampered documents (87.6%), manipulated natural images (89.6%), physical spoofs (93.1%), and AI-generated videos (96.0%). It significantly outperforms both specialized expert models and its predecessor, DefakerOne, establishing itself as a powerful and versatile foundation model for binary-decision forensic tasks.

217. 【2610.37917】What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for $π_{0.5}$ on BEHAVIOR-1K

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37917

作者：Ruben Hammele,Samira Huber,Mohammad Nazeri,Amirreza Payandeh,Alexandyr T. Card,Aaron Nguyen,Anuj Pokhrel,Daeun Song,Xuesu Xiao,Sören Pirk

类目：Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：general-purpose household robotics, household robotics, offer a promising, promising paradigm, paradigm for general-purpose

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: this https URL

218. 【2610.37882】FYC: FPR-Disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration for Fair Deepfake Detection

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37882

作者：Uzoamaka Ezeakunne,Taiwo Olabamipe,Deevesh Jain,Xiuwen Liu

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Deepfake detectors routinely, false-positive rates differ, routinely achieve high, achieve high aggregate, substantial demographic disparities

备注： 9 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deepfake detectors routinely achieve high aggregate accuracy while exhibiting substantial demographic disparities in their errors: false-positive rates differ by double digits across gender and skin tone. Most existing remedies require either full retraining with a fairness-aware objective or demographic-annotated training data, both impractical when only a pretrained checkpoint is available, while label-free post-hoc calibrators leave the detector's weights unchanged. We introduce FYC (FPR-disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration), a two-stage post-hoc method that perturbs a detector's weights under an FPR-disparity criterion, then calibrates a separate decision threshold for each demographic group - requiring no architectural changes and no full retraining. Evaluated against every detector benchmarked on AI-Face v2 across six intersectional gender x skin-tone groups, FYC outperforms the field on 18 of 21 reported fairness and utility metrics, including purpose-built fairness architectures, at a fraction of the training cost. We further identify why the choice of fairness criterion is critical: the original Demographic Parity objective used in prior weight-perturbation work is architecture-dependent and unpredictable, improving two of four evaluated architectures, leaving a third largely unchanged, and substantially degrading the fourth (PG-FDD), with no way to anticipate the outcome for a given checkpoint in advance. Conditioning the same objective on real images only - our FPR-disparity criterion - eliminates this unpredictability, improving fairness and accuracy jointly across all four architectures with no exceptions.

219. 【2610.37881】Intersectional Invariant Learning for Fair Deepfake Detection

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37881

作者：Uzoamaka Ezeakunne,Taiwo Olabamipe,Deevesh Jain,Xiuwen Liu

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Deepfake detection models, experience substantially higher, Deepfake detection, substantially higher false-positive, high overall accuracy

备注： 4 pages including appendices, 7 figures, 8 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deepfake detection models achieve high overall accuracy but exhibit large performance disparities across demographic groups, causing some groups to experience substantially higher false-positive rates than others. Existing fairness-aware methods address this by constraining model outputs to equalize group predictions, but do not tackle the underlying feature-level bias. As a result, models may still rely on demographic characteristics, such as skin texture, as indirect cues for detecting manipulated content. To address this problem, we propose Intersectional Invariant Learning (IIL), a framework that improves feature learning rather than only adjusting model outputs. IIL alternates between identifying the most challenging demographic partitions and learning features that remain consistent across those partitions. The framework also includes a false-positive-rate fairness objective and group-balanced sampling across six gender x skin-tone intersectional groups. We evaluate IIL on a large-scale fairness benchmark containing over one million images, 10 baseline detectors, and 21 fairness and utility metrics. Results show that IIL achieves Pareto-optimal performance, simultaneously attaining an AUC above 99%, a false-positive rate under 2.5%, and the lowest intersectional fairness disparity (FMEO) among all compared methods. IIL outperforms prior fairness-aware methods on the large majority of the 21 evaluation metrics, while reducing both false-positive rates and intersectional fairness disparities by several-fold compared with the strongest competing method.

220. 【2610.37874】PairCLIP-SWA: Similarity-Guided Balancing and Stochastic Weight Averaging for Generalized Deepfake Image Detection with OpenCLIP

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37874

作者：Md. Nakib,Sudipto Sarkar,A. J. A. Jubayer Talukder,Mohammad Ariful Haque

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

关键词：Deepfake detectors, choice is rarely, single checkpoint, validation accuracy, Deepfake

备注： 15 pages, 8 figures, 12 tables. Code and experiment outputs: [this https URL](https://github.com/DarkJ0Y/PairCLIP-SWA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deepfake detectors are almost always deployed as the single checkpoint that scored best on a validation split, yet the reliability of that choice is rarely measured. We measure it with PairCLIP-SWA, a single-backbone detector that adapts an OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 visual tower by progressive block unfreezing on a class-balanced corpus built by CLIP-similarity-guided one-to-one subsampling, and averages the fine-tuning trajectory in weight space. Trained in-domain on the IEEE SP Cup 2025 (DF-Wild-Cup) benchmark under the same protocol as the strongest published three-backbone ensemble, the weight-averaged detector reaches 97.04% accuracy, 98.64% AU-ROC and a 4.07% equal error rate, against 94.46%, 97.60% and 5.00%. Its training log shows why averaging matters: over the averaged epochs the non-averaged checkpoint swings across 5.34 points of validation accuracy while its validation loss more than doubles, whereas the average is never worse and is up to 5.99 points better. On an OpenForensics-derived benchmark the same instability becomes a misranking: the checkpoint that validation accuracy selects (98.43%) scores 88.85% on a disjoint 10,905-image test partition, rejecting 21.1% of genuine photographs, while the terminal average, ranked last on validation, scores 94.76%. A study of twenty-two in-house configurations on the identical DF-Wild-Cup split, including preprocessing ablations, shows that CLIP pre-training rather than ensembling drives accuracy, that secondary face cropping costs about 34 points, and that frequency-domain inputs transfer poorly. We recommend per-class selection criteria measured off the early-stopping split.

221. 【2610.37867】What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37867

作者：Saransh Kumar Gupta,Akshadha Sharma,Lipika Dey,Partha Pratim Das,Ramesh Jain

类目：Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)

关键词：food computing tasks, computing tasks, typically evaluated, Food, identity preservation

备注： 17 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables, 31 references

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.

222. 【2610.37860】Effects of Deep Learning Architecture and Pretraining on Automated Vocal Fold Segmentation in Ex Vivo High-Speed Phonation Images

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37860

作者：Varun Vinayak Kalaiarasan(1),Charles Farbos de Luzan(1 and 2),Khalid Malik(2),Ephraim Gutmark(3),Liran Oren(1 and 2) ((1) Department of Biomedical Engineering, University of Cincinnati, (2) Department of Otolaryngology, University of Cincinnati, (3) Department of Aerospace Engineering Engineering Mechanics, University of Cincinnati)

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Image and Video Processing (eess.IV); Fluid Dynamics (physics.flu-dyn)

关键词：medial surface dynamics, fold medial surface, experiments quantifies vocal, vocal fold segmentation, quantifies vocal fold

备注： 37 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Two-dimensional (2D) intraglottal particle image velocimetry (PIV) of ex vivo phonation experiments quantifies vocal fold medial surface dynamics and the intraglottal flow field. However, it relies on manual segmentation because residual glare, low tissue-to-flow contrast, and tracer-particle speckle obscure the vocal fold boundaries. This study assessed how deep learning architecture and ImageNet pretraining affect automated vocal fold segmentation in these high-speed images. Four established architectures from three categories were benchmarked: the convolutional neural network (CNN)-based UNet and UNet++, the hybrid CNN-transformer-based TransUNet, and the pure transformer-based Swin-UNet, the latter two trained from scratch and from ImageNet-pretrained weights. Using 16,344 expert-annotated images from 227 phonation trials of excised canine larynges, the six pipelines were trained with five seeds under a standardized protocol and compared on 50 held-out test trials using trial-level Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction. Mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) spanned only 0.9734 to 0.9764, so the pipelines differed mainly in boundary fidelity. Pretraining significantly improved the boundary F1 score (BF1) and 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of the TransUNet and Swin-UNet, about four times more for the Swin-UNet. Once pretrained, the two performed similarly, although the Swin-UNet has only about a quarter of the trainable parameters. Without pretraining, the TransUNet had a significantly higher BF1 and a lower HD95 than both CNN-based pipelines and about half their share of images with HD95 50 pixels. To our knowledge, this is the first study to apply deep learning to vocal fold segmentation in 2D intraglottal PIV, and it offers a reference framework for segmenting experimental flow-visualization images with noisy optical conditions or highly deformable objects.

223. 【2610.37844】Convex Potential Learning for Optimal Transport Between Medical Images

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37844

作者：Hongyu Kan,Ivan Medri,Natasha Ironside,Kristofor Pas,Richard Corp,Shinjini Kundu,Gustavo Kunde Rohde

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Computing optimal transport, Computing optimal, optimal transport maps, plays a fundamental, fundamental role

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.

224. 【2610.37823】Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37823

作者：Han Wang,Jingyuan Bao,Juntao Wu,Saiao Zhou,Yuman Nie

类目：Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：similar sensors emit, sensors emit asynchronous, emit asynchronous events, spiking cochleas, frames or packets

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

225. 【2610.37818】GOFish: Full Field-of-View Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Extraction

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37818

作者：Allen Tu,Meher Gitika Karumuri,Shifan Zhu,Hailing Wang,Yen-Liang Lin,David Held,Matthias Zwicker,Tom Goldstein

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Graphics (cs.GR); Robotics (cs.RO)

关键词：fisheye Gaussian Splatting, Gaussian Splatting methods, Gaussian Splatting surface, autonomous vehicles, Gaussian Splatting

备注： Project Page: [this https URL](https://3dgofish.github.io/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Robots, autonomous vehicles, and consumer 360° cameras use fisheye lenses for wide fields of view (FoVs). Simulation-ready digital twins require photorealistic rendering across the full FoV and an aligned collision mesh. However, prior fisheye Gaussian Splatting methods only rasterize up to 180° and do not produce meshes, while Gaussian surface reconstruction methods assume pinhole training images. We present GOFish, the first 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method to train directly on fisheye images, rasterize FoVs beyond 180°, and extract an aligned mesh from the same scene. Calibrated densification recovers the surface across the entire FoV, while Calibrated Mip Filtering and Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling keep pixel blur and lens falloff out of the scene and mesh. Across the 200° FIORD and 205° FullCircle benchmarks, GOFish improves PSNR over the best prior method by 2.28 and 1.97 dB, respectively. It also outperforms fisheye rendering baselines within their own FoVs and achieves the highest mesh F-score on FIORD and the main ScanNet++ set. Together, the Gaussian scene and mesh form a LiDAR-free, simulation-ready digital twin that renders in real time, ray traces the full FoV, and provides collision geometry.

226. 【2610.37806】ACOS: Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision for Visual Footstep Planning

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37806

作者：Jean-Michel Fortin,William Larrivée-Hardy,Gabriel Jeanson,Olivier Gamache,Daniele De Martini,François Pomerleau,Philippe Giguère

类目：Robotics (cs.RO); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Humans navigate, vision system, navigate their environment, ground will respond, respond before committing

备注： 9 pages, 8 figures, Submitted to ICRA 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Humans navigate their environment based on their vision system, anticipating how the ground will respond before committing to a step. Self-supervised learning could provide legged robots the same ability, but the supervisory signal is typically chosen on intuition, and its effect on what the model learns is rarely examined. We present Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision (TACOS), which proposes a meaningful and consistent footstep instability score, based on the residual of a factor graph in legged state estimation. It projects the continuous score into preceding images to supervise a dense visual predictor. We propose two variants, a hard score that exploits hindsight and a causal soft score available immediately. Both metrics are compared against state-of-the-art alternatives in two independent evaluations that share no data or labels. On 1716 manually annotated contacts, both variants outperform every evaluated alternative at detecting instability and ranking its severity, improving pooled severity ranking by 28 % over the strongest baseline. On three outdoor test runs, our metric also trains the most accurate visual predictor, improving rank correlation by 58 % over the strongest alternative, and by a further 25 % when supplemented with onboard context. In a real-world experiment over a 50 m forest trajectory, the trained predictor handles non-geometric terrain properties such as mud and vegetation, while stepping around geometric obstacles like fallen branches. Code is available for reproducibility at this https URL.

227. 【2610.37784】Sparse tensor networks for individual tree diameter estimation in mixed forests

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37784

作者：Clara Lößl,Fabian Ewald Fassnacht,Viacheslav Barkov

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：breast height, regions are impractical, ULS, Quantitative Structure Models, diameter at breast

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Measurements of tree diameter at breast height (DBH) are fundamental to forest inventories, but manual surveys across entire stands or regions are impractical. UAV-borne laser scanning (ULS) enables scalable automated forest surveys, yet canopy occlusion makes accurate DBH estimation from ULS point clouds non-trivial. Limited stem-level point density of ULS data constrains approaches relying on detailed stem reconstruction, such as Quantitative Structure Models (QSMs) and circle fitting. Empirical machine learning methods based on predefined point cloud metrics are an alternative. New deep learning approaches offer an even more principled solution, allowing models to learn directly from point clouds. Sparse tensor networks have shown particular promise, transforming forestry tasks such as tree species classification. We investigate whether these strengths can be extended to estimate individual tree DBH from ULS data across four mixed-species temperate forest plots in Germany. We further advance existing sparse tensor networks by introducing TreeNext, a lightweight deep learning architecture for direct individual tree parameter estimation from voxelized LiDAR point clouds. We present a fully automated forest inventory pipeline from individual tree instance segmentation to DBH regression, and quantify the impact of segmentation errors by comparing performance on automatically segmented and ground truth instances. TreeNext achieves an $R^2$ of 0.8355 on automatically segmented trees and 0.9380 on ground truth segments, outperforming strong tabular baselines including Random Forest and XGBoost. Segmentation quality emerges as the dominant error source in the automated pipeline. TreeNext proves highly data-efficient, performing well even in small data scenarios. Our findings establish sparse tensor networks as a practical foundation for automated individual tree DBH estimation from ULS.

228. 【2607.21628】Wavelet Phase Diffusion for Structurally and Semantically Consistent Sim-to-Real Translation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21628

作者：Kaiwen Wang,Frank Bieder,Yinzhe Shen,Carlos Fernandez,Jan-Hendrik Pauls,Omer Sahin Tas

类目：Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Image and Video Processing (eess.IV)

关键词：semantic consistency, methods, methods achieve, semantic, Conditioning-based methods achieve

备注： Accepted by WACV 2027. 20 pages, 15 figures. Project page: [this https URL](https://kit-mrt.github.io/Wavelet-Phase-Diffusion/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference. Second, Low-Frequency Randomization (LFR) replaces the low-frequency packet, decoupling the model from the synthetic illumination prior and enabling in-distribution real-world appearance. Both components train on unpaired open-domain data, and introduce negligible inference overhead. The spatial locality further enables instance-level translation, where individual objects or regions are translated to photorealistic appearance independently while the surrounding scene remains untranslated. On vKITTI $\to$ KITTI image translation, $\psi$-PD outperforms prior methods in realism and semantic consistency while maintaining competitive structural alignment. For CARLA video translation, $\psi$-PD approaches the realism of paired-data methods while reducing VLM planner ADE and FDE by $5.4\%$ and $5.1\%$, respectively.

229. 【2607.03487】owards Diverse and Comprehensive Benchmarks for Mutual Information Estimation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03487

作者：Alberto Foresti,Ivan Butakov,Alexander Tolmachev,Giulio Franzese,Alexey Frolov,Pietro Michiardi

类目：Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Information Theory (cs.IT)

关键词：Mutual information, data largely unexplored, realistic data largely, existing benchmarks typically, low-dimensional distributions

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mutual information (MI) estimation is a central problem in machine learning and statistics; however, existing benchmarks typically evaluate estimators on simplified, low-dimensional distributions, leaving their performance on complex, realistic data largely unexplored. We address this gap with a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in a unified copula-theoretic perspective that subsumes existing benchmarks as special cases. Within this framework, we propose two complementary families of tests: a copula-first family that systematically varies ground-truth MI, dimensionality, and marginal complexity using synthetic and flow-based transformations; and a marginals-first family that couples real-world image data with controlled dependency structures, extending the classic same-class-pairing paradigm. We use this suite to extensively evaluate three classes of estimators: non-parametric, discriminative, and generative. Contrary to prevailing assumptions, our results indicate that there is no universal winner: each category can systematically outperform all other estimators under specific setups. By analyzing these cases, we identify fundamental estimation barriers and propose new tests that more effectively stress these specific limitations. We share the open source code at this https URL.

230. 【2606.15768】LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15768

作者：Jialei Chen,Kai Wang,Kang Chen,Shuaihang Chen,Feng Gao,Wenhao Tang,Zhiyuan Li,Weilin Liu,Zhuyu Yao,Boxun Li,Yuanbo Xu,Chao Yu

类目：Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：leverage large-scale vision-language, large-scale vision-language pretraining, lack explicit foresight, leverage large-scale, large-scale vision-language

备注： Accepted at CoRL 2026. Project website: [this https URL](https://rlinf.github.io/LaWAM/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

231. 【2610.39972】Blind Video Denoising for Vocal Tract rtMRI using a Self-Supervised Ensemble

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39972

作者：Julian Andres Hernandez-Potes,Tomás Arias-Vergara,Daiqi Liu,Andreas Maier,Paula Andrea Perez-Toro

类目：Image and Video Processing (eess.IV); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Real-time magnetic resonance, articulation directly observable, magnetic resonance imaging, makes speech articulation, speech articulation directly

备注： 7 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Real-time magnetic resonance imaging of the vocal tract makes speech articulation directly observable, but the trade-off between temporal resolution and signal quality introduces substantial noise and obscures fine articulatory detail. Since clean references cannot be acquired for a moving vocal tract, supervised denoising approaches are not applicable in this setting. We propose a self-supervised denoising framework that combines spatiotemporal super-resolution learning with pseudo-supervision derived from a variance-stabilized non-local means filter. A dual-model fusion strategy balances noise suppression and preservation of high-frequency articulatory structure. Experiments on the USC-75 multi-speaker dataset under natural noise conditions show that the ensemble raises the signal-to-noise ratio by 11.9 dB on unseen subjects while attaining more high-frequency articulatory content in the frames. Among tuned implementations of anisotropic diffusion, block-matching filtering, non-local means and pre-smoothed non-local means, every configuration that achieves comparable noise suppression does so at the cost of high-frequency content or of structural fidelity. Under severe added Gaussian, Rayleigh and Rician noise, peak signal-to-noise ratio improves by 7.6 to 11.8 dB and structural similarity roughly triples. An ablation shows that the variance-stabilized pseudo-supervision is an essential element for denoising, and that the effect is attributable to the hard thresholding contained in the stabilization transform.

232. 【2610.38530】From the Superderivative to a Relative-Gradient Edge Operator

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38530

作者：Alejandro Garnung Menéndez

类目：Image and Video Processing (eess.IV); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Roberts and Scharr, Scharr measure absolute, absolute grey-level differences, First-derivative edge detectors, measure absolute grey-level

备注： 15 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:First-derivative edge detectors such as Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts and Scharr measure absolute grey-level differences. We revisit the log-gradient magnitude, a relative-gradient edge operator, and motivate it by analogy with the superderivative, a multiplicative derivative in which the independent variable is perturbed multiplicatively rather than additively. In one and two dimensions the logarithm of the superderivative is a radial logarithmic derivative; its local, origin-free, isotropic analogue is the magnitude of the logarithmic gradient. The resulting operator measures relative rather than absolute change, giving an edge-strength map that is invariant under global intensity rescaling. We present the theory, show how the operator can be implemented in two steps---a classical gradient kernel plus a pointwise division---and compare it with standard first-derivative filters on synthetic images with ground-truth edges and on the official BSDS500 benchmark. We also study a parametric family that interpolates between the absolute gradient and the log-gradient; empirically, the best members are small intermediate exponents, which edge the classical kernels by a small but statistically detectable margin in the per-image metric and, with the same Gaussian smoothing as the single-$\sigma$ Canny, match it in ODS and lead it in OIS and AP, while the tuned Canny remains ahead in ODS. The single-threshold margin over the kernels does not replicate on the held-out test split, and the fully relative endpoint is never the best member, its ranking depending on the edge-map normalisation. The contribution is the construction and the invariance it buys, not a new state of the art.

233. 【2610.37709】owards Myocardial Infarction Diagnosis: An Investigation into Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms using ECG Data

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37709

作者：Rafid Ahnaf,Husne Mubarak,Fahim Ahsan,G. M. Refatul Islam,Rafeed Rahman,Nabuat Zaman Nahim

类目：Image and Video Processing (eess.IV); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：myocardial injury due, potentially fatal cardiac, fatal cardiac condition, cardiac condition caused, Myocardial Infarction

备注： 18 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Based on the authors' undergraduate thesis at BRAC University (2023)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Myocardial Infarction (MI) is a severe and potentially fatal cardiac condition caused by myocardial injury due to ischemia, and timely detection can substantially reduce its mortality. Electrocardiography (ECG) is the primary diagnostic modality for MI, but manual interpretation is susceptible to human error. In this work, we propose Visionary V2, a multi-step, adaptive filtration method for ECG signal normalization, and use it to study machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches to MI detection on the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database using all 15 available leads. On statistical features extracted from the filtered signals, such as the R-R interval, a Bagging ensemble of decision trees reaches 96.6% accuracy, compared with 87.7% when the signals are processed with BioSPPy. We further generate an image dataset from the filtered signals, on which a custom ResNet-50 misclassifies only 1 of 7,000 validation images and a custom CNN reaches an F1 score of about 98.7%. Finally, we apply LIME, Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients to verify that the image models attend to the ECG waveform rather than the background. These results indicate that careful signal normalization combined with ML and DL models can support fast and accurate automated MI screening.
